scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Apply to become a Priest in the Prontera Church (prt_church 16, 41) by speaking to Bishop Paul.
1.short_ru: Подайте заявку у Bishop Paul: prt_church 16, 41.
1.full_ru: Подайте заявку на профессию Priest у Bishop Paul в Prontera Church (prt_church 16, 41).
1.full_en: Apply to become a Priest in the Prontera Church (prt_church 16, 41) by speaking to Bishop Paul.

2.original_instruction: You must visit all three Ascetics from the Acolyte Job Quest . However, this step may be skipped by Job Level 50 Acolytes .
2.short_ru: Посетите всех трёх Ascetics из Acolyte Job Quest; при Job Level 50 этап можно пропустить.
2.short_en: Visit all three Ascetics from Acolyte Job Quest; Job Level 50 permits skipping this stage.
2.full_ru: Посетите всех трёх Ascetics из Acolyte Job Quest. Этот этап могут пропустить Acolytes с Job Level 50.
2.full_en: You must visit all three Ascetics from the Acolyte Job Quest . However, this step may be skipped by Job Level 50 Acolytes .

requirements.condition: All three Ascetics referenced by Acolyte Job Quest; exempt only at Job Level 50.

actions.condition: Required unless Job Level 50; names/points are not independently printed in this guide.

3.original_instruction: After returning from the three Ascetics, Bishop Paul grants you access to a room where the next two tests will take place: Exorcism and Temptation.
3.short_ru: Вернитесь к Bishop Paul и войдите в комнату Exorcism и Temptation.
3.short_en: Return to Bishop Paul and enter the Exorcism and Temptation room.
3.full_ru: После возвращения от трёх Ascetics Bishop Paul откроет доступ в комнату следующих двух испытаний: Exorcism и Temptation. Правило предыдущего этапа: посетите всех трёх Ascetics из Acolyte Job Quest; Acolytes с Job Level 50 могут пропустить эти посещения.
3.full_en: After returning from the three Ascetics, Bishop Paul grants you access to a room where the next two tests will take place: Exorcism and Temptation. You must visit all three Ascetics from the Acolyte Job Quest .  However, this step may be skipped by Job Level 50 Acolytes .

actions.condition: After the applicable ascetic-visit stage; Job Level 50 exemption does not require fabricating completed visits.

source_additions.text_ru: Правило предыдущего этапа: посетите всех трёх Ascetics из Acolyte Job Quest; Acolytes с Job Level 50 могут пропустить эти посещения.

4.original_instruction: In this room, click Peter S. Alberto multiple times to activate his dialogue window. The excessive clicking required is actually part of the test, not a bug. A Priest can come along to help for these two tests by following the same instructions and bringing a Rosary in their inventory (not equipped).
4.short_ru: Повторно нажимайте на Peter S. Alberto до открытия диалога; помощь другого Priest необязательна.
4.short_en: Click Peter S. Alberto repeatedly until dialogue opens; another Priest's help is optional.
4.full_ru: В комнате многократно нажмите на Peter S. Alberto, пока не откроется диалог. Многочисленные нажатия — часть испытания, а не ошибка. Другой Priest может помочь в этих двух испытаниях: ему нужно выполнить те же инструкции и держать Rosary в инвентаре, не надевая его.
4.full_en: In this room, click Peter S. Alberto multiple times to activate his dialogue window. The excessive clicking required is actually part of the test, not a bug. A Priest can come along to help for these two tests by following the same instructions and bringing a Rosary in their inventory (not equipped).

5.original_instruction: In the next few rooms, Heal "bomb" all the Zombie that appear. All must be killed in each room to clear the Exorcism stage and move onto Temptation.
5.short_ru: Используйте Heal против всех появляющихся Zombie в каждой комнате Exorcism.
5.short_en: Use Heal on all Zombie spawns in each Exorcism room.
5.full_ru: В следующих комнатах убивайте всех появляющихся Zombie с помощью Heal. Для прохождения Exorcism и перехода к Temptation нужно зачистить каждую комнату.
5.full_en: In the next few rooms, Heal "bomb" all the Zombie that appear. All must be killed in each room to clear the Exorcism stage and move onto Temptation.

6.original_instruction: Successfully walk past four NPCs (Deviruchi, Doppleganger, Dark Lord, and finally Baphomet) without accepting their deals. Some may offer bribes or insist Priest life is too difficult to be worthwhile, but choose options that reject their offers.

6.short_en: Reject Deviruchi, Doppleganger, Dark Lord and Baphomet in order.
6.full_ru: Пройдите мимо четырёх NPC по порядку: Deviruchi, Doppleganger, Dark Lord и Baphomet. Не принимайте их сделки: отвергайте подкуп и предложения отказаться от жизни Priest.

8.original_instruction: After exiting the last room, you'll be warped back to Bishop Paul. He suggests speaking with Sister Cecelia on the other side of the room. Employ common sense to answer her questions with holy and righteous responses to pass it.
8.short_ru: У Bishop Paul получите направление к Sister Cecelia и дайте благочестивые ответы.
8.short_en: Follow Bishop Paul's referral to Sister Cecelia and give righteous answers.
8.full_ru: После выхода из последней комнаты вас перенесёт к Bishop Paul. Он направит к Sister Cecelia на другой стороне комнаты. Отвечайте на её вопросы благочестиво и праведно, руководствуясь здравым смыслом.
8.full_en: After exiting the last room, you'll be warped back to Bishop Paul. He suggests speaking with Sister Cecelia on the other side of the room. Employ common sense to answer her questions with holy and righteous responses to pass it.

reviews.detail: All three Ascetics are required unless Job Level 50. This differs from the one assigned option in Acolyte job change. The own-guide HTML Acolyte Job Quest link resolves Acolyte_Job_Change_Guide, but this is a visit-group reference, not a newly asserted mandatory quest-completion relation. Actor names/points are not copied without own-guide evidence. The following test-room step preserves the skip context.

The optional assisting character must be Priest and keep Rosary 2608 in inventory, not equipped. It is neither consumed nor an extra applicant cost; Holy Light uses the same linked item with a different role. Peter S. Alberto repeated clicks are intentional with unknown count.

Exorcism clears all actual Zombie spawns with unknown totals. Later Zombie/Mummies rooms can be run through. Deviruchi, Doppleganger, Dark Lord and Baphomet are ordered temptation NPCs, not four mandatory bosses. Exact rejection and Sister Cecelia answers are absent; no literal dialogue is fabricated.

Bible 1551 and Book 1550 are exact own-guide links with exclusive job-level rewards. Bishop Paul is not automatically merged with the unnamed Acolyte church Priest or Holy Light Cleric; only his own interior map point is asserted.

routes.condition: All three visits are required unless the applicant is Job Level 50, when this step may be skipped. Conditional exemption, not a free skip for lower job levels.
